description: This file contains shell functions for managing git worktrees, especially in the context of pull requests. Core functionalities include identifying the repository root, entering specific worktrees, retrieving PR metadata, writing metadata to files, listing existing PR worktrees, and cleaning up merged or closed PR worktrees. The script heavily utilizes git and GitHub CLI commands to automate pull request management tasks.

methods.name: repo_root
methods.description: Resolves the canonical root directory of the repository, handling linked worktrees using git common-dir.

methods.name: enter_worktree
methods.description: Checks out a specific PR's worktree, optionally resetting it to the latest main branch.

methods.name: pr_meta_json
methods.description: Retrieves PR metadata in JSON format from GitHub using the PR number.

methods.name: write_pr_meta_files
methods.description: Writes PR metadata JSON to a local file and extracts specific fields for environment variables.

methods.name: list_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Lists all existing PR worktrees with their statuses and information.

methods.name: gc_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Garbage collection of PR worktrees that are closed or merged, with a dry-run option.

methods.name: pr_number_from_worktree_dir
methods.description: Extracts the PR number from a worktree directory name.
